name: python
description:
Run Python code in a persistent session (variables persist across calls, like a notebook). numpy is available as `np` and torch as `torch` (CPU only, 2 threads). `weights` is a dict of read-only, memory-mapped float32 numpy arrays (use np.array(a) for a writable copy), torch nn.Linear layout [out, in]. Model X tensors (Model Y has the same names with the prefix `Y.`):
  X.layers.0.input_layernorm.weight: [640]
  X.layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight: [640, 2048]
  X.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight: [2048, 640]
  X.layers.0.mlp.up_proj.weight: [2048, 640]
  X.layers.0.post_attention_layernorm.weight: [640]
  X.layers.0.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight: [640]
  X.layers.0.pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight: [640]
  X.layers.0.self_attn.k_norm.weight: [256]
  X.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.weight: [256, 640]
  X.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj.weight: [640, 1024]
  X.layers.0.self_attn.q_norm.weight: [256]
  X.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight: [1024, 640]
  X.layers.0.self_attn.v_proj.weight: [256, 640]
  (same for layers 1-17)
Shared (frozen, identical in both): shared.embed_tokens.weight [262144, 640], shared.norm.weight [640]. `vocab` = list of 262144 token strings.
stdout and the value of the last expression are returned (truncated to 20000 chars). Each call times out after 180s. No file system or network access.
